metadata.title: Advanced Professional Mosaic: Expert Industry Standards
metadata.notes: Expert-level mapping of global professional standards for civilizational infrastructure.

nodes.title: LEED Green Associate
nodes.description: The standard for green building. Sustainable sites, water efficiency, energy and atmosphere, materials and resources, and indoor environmental quality. Linked to the Regenerative Habitat track.

nodes.title: OSHA 40-Hour HAZWOPER
nodes.description: Hazardous Waste Operations and Emergency Response. Safety training for cleaning up hazardous waste sites. Linked to the Planetary Repair track.

nodes.title: Red Hat Certified System Administrator (RHCSA)
nodes.description: Professional Linux systems administration. Command line, local storage, file systems, and security. Directly linked to the NixOS and Sovereign IT tracks.

nodes.title: Certified Information Systems Security Professional
nodes.description: The elite cybersecurity standard. Risk management, asset security, identity and access management, and network security. Mapping MATL math to CISSP domains.

nodes.title: APICS Certified Supply Chain Professional (CSCP)
nodes.description: End-to-end supply chain management. Sourcing, procurement, and fulfillment. Mapping the Mycelial Oracle logic to global logistics standards.

edges.rationale: Bio-material mastery covers 80% of the LEED Materials & Resources credit requirements.
Active carbon scrubbing and remediation requires OSHA hazardous waste safety training.
Sovereign hardware security provides the root-of-trust needed for Linux sysadmin.
Global mesh governance provides the systemic intuition for global supply chain management.
